A variant that updates codewords using subsets of input vectors to reduce computational cost.
It initializes the first center randomly and samples each subsequent center with probability proportional to its squared distance from the nearest selected center.
**Performance:** The method allows processing of large datasets (e.g., 1.2GB hyperspectral images) by limiting the number of points used for clustering.
The method is used in multivariate volume visualization through dynamic projections, particularly for earth remote sensing and hyperspectral imaging.
